summary: Structured writing can force useful prioritization, is easier to scan and may be safer than retaining sensitive audio.

points.text: Long monologues often contain repeated, conflicting or speculative statements; an agent may anchor on a vivid aside rather than the actual requirement.
Speech recognition quality varies with language, accent, noise and technical vocabulary, creating unequal error rates and extra correction work.
Audio may capture bystanders, customer information or secrets. Recording, retention and third-party transcription require explicit privacy policy and consent.
